clues: This city sits on a peninsula in southwest Norway. It lies by the sea in the far north of Europe.
The close sea keeps winters mild in this cold north land. Most winter days stay above freezing, and heat waves are rare.
Its start is counted from the year eleven twenty-five. That year, workers finished the big church at its heart.
This place is known as the oil capital of its land. A huge oil firm has its main base here.
Its heart is full of old wood homes that are kept safe. They give the big city a warm small town feel.
